title: Discovery of Novel and Potent Prolyl Hydroxylase Domain-Containing Protein (PHD) Inhibitors for The Treatment of Anemia.
authors: Xu, Jianyu; Ding, Xiaoyu; Fu, Yanyun; Meng, Qingyuan; Wang, Ling; Zhang, Man; Xu, Chenxi; Chen, Shan; Aliper, Alex; Ren, Feng; Zhavoronkov, Alex; Ding, Xiao
one_liner_zh: 该文研究PHD抑制剂治疗贫血，属于小分子药物发现，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Stabilization of hypoxia-inducible factor (HIF) by inhibiting prolyl hydroxylase domain enzymes (PHDs) represents a breakthrough in treating anemia associated with chronic kidney disease. Here, we identified a novel scaffold for noncarboxylic PHD inhibitors by utilizing structure-based drug design (SBDD) and generative models. Iterative optimization of potency and solubility resulted in compound 15 which potently inhibits PHD thus stabilizing HIF-alpha in vitro. X-ray cocrystal structure confirmed the binding model was distinct from previously reported carboxylic acid PHD inhibitors by pushing away the R383 and Y303 residues resulting in a larger inner subpocket. Furthermore, compound 15 demonstrated a favorable in vitro/in vivo absorption, distribution, metabolism, and excretion (ADME) profile, low drug-drug interaction risk, and clean early safety profiling. Functionally, oral administration of compound 15 at 10 mg/kg every day (QD) mitigated anemia in a 5/6 nephrectomy rat disease model.
abstract_zh: 通过抑制脯氨酰羟化酶结构域酶（PHDs）来稳定缺氧诱导因子（HIF），是治疗慢性肾脏病相关贫血的一项突破。在此，我们利用基于结构的药物设计（SBDD）和生成模型，识别出一种新型非羧酸类PHD抑制剂骨架。通过迭代优化效力和溶解度，得到化合物15，该化合物能有效抑制PHD，从而在体外稳定HIF-α。X射线共晶结构确认，其结合模式与先前报道的羧酸类PHD抑制剂不同，通过推开R383和Y303残基，形成更大的内部亚口袋。此外，化合物15表现出良好的体外/体内吸收、分布、代谢和排泄（ADME）特性，低药物相互作用风险，以及良好的早期安全性特征。在功能上，以10 mg/kg每日一次（QD）口服给药化合物15，在5/6肾切除大鼠疾病模型中缓解了贫血。
